plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp endurance-first build for boxing with enough strength and power work to support athleticism without stealing recovery from skill work. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the two main percentage lifts, then Weeks 2-4 build steady lower-body and upper-body strength, simple explosive work, and dedicated conditioning. Review recovery, boxing load, and conditioning quality at the end of Week 4 before the next block.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build aerobic capacity and repeatable work capacity while establishing baseline strength and keeping power work simple and crisp.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and conditioning density while keeping fatigue recoverable around boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep the strength base, sharpen power and speed output, and maintain conditioning with less unnecessary fatigue.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump fast and land quietly. Stop each rep short of any sloppy landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low box and stick the landing.

exercises.name: 2. Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up in small jumps, then build to one hard set of 3-5 reps with clean depth and no grindy form. This sets your baseline for future percentage work.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if shoulder mobility makes back squat setup awkward.

exercises.name: 3a. Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Use a steady tempo and finish with the elbows, not the neck.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Keep the torso quiet and pull to the lower ribs.

exercises.name: 3b. Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Ribs down, glutes on, and only roll out as far as you can control.

substitutionOptions.name: Stability Ball Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the wheel is too demanding.

exercises.name: 4. Assault Bike Aerobic Intervals
exercises.notes: Stay smooth and controlled. You should finish feeling worked, not smashed.

endurancePrescription.intensity: Easy to moderate effort, nasal breathing or short sentences possible
endurancePrescription.target: Build aerobic base without extra impact
